additions.description: GET /items/ endpoint returns all items without filtering by owner or supporting query parameters
additions.reasoning: The specification requires that retrieving items as a superuser returns at least the created items, implying support for listing items. The code implements GET /items/ returning all items unconditionally, which is more permissive than the specification that implies user-based access control or filtering.

additions.description: GET /users/ endpoint returns all users with no pagination or filtering parameters
additions.reasoning: The specification requires retrieving all users as a superuser but does not specify pagination or filtering. The code returns all users unconditionally, which is an addition as no pagination or filtering is required.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/items/ does not verify that the response status code is 200 as required by the specification

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not check permissions to ensure only owner or superuser can read the item
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires that a user cannot read an item owned by another user (returns 400 with 'Not enough permissions'), but the code allows any authenticated user to read any item without permission checks.

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not return 400 with 'Not enough permissions' when a non-owner normal user attempts to read an item
omissions.reasoning: The specification requires a 400 status with detail 'Not enough permissions' when a user tries to read an item they do not own, but the code returns the item without such a check.

omissions.reasoning: The code returns 404 with 'Item not found' when the item is missing, which matches the specification, so no omission here.
